'''Cobal''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where a small group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had settled. These Jedi wore unique [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]], appearing like casual clothing that was patterned brown and turquoise with one sleeve being larger than the other. Their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] were known to shoot sparks erratically, due to the turqoise [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|unique crystals]] [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on Cobal.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], replications of their robes and lightsabers were available to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Cobal was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
